## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><ol><li>Open Files (folder) on the left toolbar and clear the checkbox beside the BIM prefab facade file to identify the frame behind it.</li><li>Compare a facade panel with the nearby floor and structural components.</li><li>Select a component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to inspect its properties and source model. Repeat with a component from another discipline.</li></ol><h2>Developer integration</h2><p>Use repeated <code>viewer.add()</code> calls to federate the three IFCs. File visibility and properties remain SDK controls. This example focuses on discipline interfaces and imports the original source files unchanged.</p><p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
<h3>Model notes</h3><p>The original IFC source is imported unchanged.</p>
